issue.title: Finalizer provenance_id exceeds core's 160-byte bound for long config-layer paths
issue.description:
Discovered by the sase-1t2.8.1 land agent while running the epic's finalizer canaries
(tests/fakey/test_agent_hijack_canary.py) with raw pytest under the long SASE agent TMPDIR.

Root cause: src/sase/finalizers/config.py:_primary_provenance_id (and the twin
catalog.py:_provenance_id) builds each finalizer instance's provenance_id as
`<layer>:<absolute config path>`. sase-core finalizer/selection.rs validates
`provenance_id` with validate_optional_bounded_text(..., FINALIZER_PROVENANCE_MAX_LEN=160)
(introduced in 09576c3a "add shared finalizer protocol"). When the absolute path of the
config layer that declares a finalizer instance is longer than ~150 bytes, every prompt
selecting that finalizer fails at plan resolution with
`FinalizerPlanError: invalid finalizer plan: provenance_id must be nonblank and at most 160 bytes`,
the agent run FAILS before the provider starts, and the workspace is held.

Fix direction: produce a bounded, deterministic provenance id (e.g. keep the layer
name and elide the head of the path, or layer + short path digest) on every Python
producer so plan wire, catalog, and plan.py:301 comparison stay consistent; or move the
bounding into sase-core so all callers share it. Add a regression test with a >160-byte
layer path.

task_type_fields.impact:
Any project or user whose sase.yml (or other finalizer-declaring config layer) lives at
an absolute path over ~150 bytes cannot run agents with that finalizer: the turn fails
before the provider runs and holds its workspace. Rare for typical paths (~80 bytes) but
silent and total when hit; raw-pytest runs of finalizer-configured fakey tests in SASE
agent environments also fail for this reason.
task_type_fields.repro:
In a sase checkout: `TMPDIR=/home/bryan/.cache/sase/tmp/agent-tmp/gh_sase-org__sase-ws0-261116_041043 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/fakey/test_agent_hijack_canary.py -k without_handoff`
fails (fakey barrier never starts; workflow log shows the FinalizerPlanError). The
provenance id there was 183 bytes:
`local:<TMPDIR>/pytest-of-bryan/pytest-4/home-d8s435nf/.local/state/sase/workspaces/primary-ed36faba/primary_3/sase.yml`.
The same test passes with `TMPDIR=/tmp/lc` and under tools/run_pytest (which redirects
TMPDIR to /var/tmp/sase-<hash>), so the default test lanes do not catch it.

issue.creation_reason: Found while landing epic sase-1t2.8.1: a pre-existing finalizer limit makes the epic's new finalizer canaries (and real agents with long config paths) fail before the provider starts. The bug is in the finalizer provenance id, not the hijack latch work.
